items.html:
NEEDS YOU

Should coupons stack with sale prices?

The old checkout applies a coupon after sale prices, so a 20% coupon on a 30% sale item gives 44% off. The new rules engine can do either.

  • Stack (today's behaviour): simpler to explain, costs more margin.
  • Best of: the customer gets the larger discount only.

I recommend best of, because the margin report shows stacked discounts on 6% of orders. Confirm?
